name: @ram0/opencode-plugin
description: Self-hosted Ram0 durable-memory automation for OpenCode

scripts.verify-exports: bun -e "import {existsSync} from 'node:fs'; import pkg from './package.json'; for (const file of [pkg.main,pkg.types,pkg.exports['.'].types,pkg.exports['.'].import]) if (!existsSync(file.replace(/^\.\//,''))) throw new Error('missing export '+file)"
scripts.build: bun run prepare-skills && bun run clean && bun build opencode-ram0.ts --outdir dist --target bun --format esm --entry-naming index.[ext] && tsc --noEmit false --emitDeclarationOnly && bun run verify-exports
